name: anvil
description: Keeps the prompt cache warm while you are away and stops an accidental cold send, draws a line above the prompt with the folder, git status, 5h and 7d usage and session cost, and adds each reply's output speed to its closing line

threshold.title: Context threshold
threshold.description: In tokens. Sessions whose context reaches it get cache keepalive automatically, and only these sessions are covered by the cold-send guard

autoKeepalive.title: Auto-enable cache keepalive
autoKeepalive.description: Sets the default: when on, sessions whose context reaches the threshold get cache keepalive automatically. /anvil keepalive toggles it for a single session, regardless of this setting and the threshold

guard.title: Cold-send guard
guard.description: When the cache has expired and the context reaches the threshold, holds back the first message to the model once and shows what rebuilding the cache will cost
